description: Change one of the signed-in user's QR codes: point it to a new link, rename it, pause it or switch it back on. The printed QR stays exactly the same; the next scan opens the new link. A paused QR shows a "paused" page instead of the link until it is switched back on. Get the id from my_qr_codes. Read the change back to the user before calling this.

id.description: The QR id (10 letters and numbers), from my_qr_codes or create_qr_code.

link.description: The new link it should open.

status.description: "paused" to stop it for now, "active" to switch it back on.

name: update_qr_code
title: Change a QR code
